notifications.ai_messages_details: Turning this off dismisses existing in-app AI toasts and hides new completion and confirmation toasts. appearance.background_color_description: Overrides the terminal background supplied by the theme. This also changes the color reported to applications by OSC 11, which TUIs use to choose light or dark mode.
appearance.background_cover_title: Extend the background image beneath window controls?
appearance.background_cover_description: The image will extend beneath the title bar, window buttons, tabs, and SSH sidebar. Low-contrast images may make controls harder to see; the interface retains a minimum-opacity safeguard.

font.fallback_description: The first family is preferred; missing glyphs fall back through the remaining families, with bundled Maple as the final safe fallback.
